text:
jess (AE): Morning team — Velaris kickoff today at 3pm PT. Need final agenda + success criteria to share with customer. Can we confirm stakeholders and whether they'll provide prompt corpora for evals?

omar (SE): I can take the integration checklist. Do we have their infra notes? They said SSO + VPC peering maybe.

lee (CSM): Stakeholders: Dana (Prod PM), Rohan (Infra), Priya (Data). Dana will own success metrics. She said they'd send sample prompts later today.

sasha (Solutions Eng): On prompts/evals: we'll want a small eval harness. Proposed success criteria:
- Functional: 90% pass on 100-shot eval set (intent accuracy / rerank precision)
- Performance: p95 latency <= 250ms for typical 512-token seq
- Stability: no more than 2 errors/hour under 50 concurrent users
- Cost: estimated < $0.20 per 1k inference tokens during POC
If they can't provide prompts, we can seed with their public dataset.

omar (SE): Questions for security: do they need SOC2 in place, data residency, KMS? Also SAML/SCIM for user provisioning. Lee — did legal flag any IP retention issues in their questionnaire?

lee (CSM): Legal asked about data retention and model fine-tuning. Velaris wants no model tuning in hosted environment and 30-day retention. They also requested a completed security questionnaire by EOD Friday.

security-bot: Reminder: attach redwood_sg_security_q1.pdf and fill SAML config template. Link: https://share.redwood/sec/velaris_q

sasha (Solutions Eng): Proposed POC timeline:
Week 0: kickoff + provide SSO details + sample prompts
Week 1: integration + basic inference smoke tests
Week 2: evals, tuning of batching/quant settings, final report
Can we commit to delivering the eval harness by Wednesday?

jess (AE): I'll confirm stakeholders and push for prompts tonight. On pricing the customer asked about a capped pilot rate — propose: demo credits + temporary capped billing with a $5k soft cap. Alex, can you confirm with finance?

alex (Sales Ops): We can set a $5k soft cap for the pilot and enable alerts. For Dedicated capacity ask: they'd need committed monthly minimum; that's negotiable with finance.

omar (SE): Blockers: VPC peering requires their infra approval and our network team SLA. I'll open a ticket with eng-infra now and tag them.

sasha (Solutions Eng): For the eval harness, here's a starter prompt snippet:
```
Prompt: "Summarize the user's request and suggest 3 follow-up questions."
Eval metric: BLEU + human pass/fail
```

jess (AE): Perfect. I'll send consolidated agenda + success criteria doc to Dana and Rohan in 30m. :thumbsup:
